l0_assessment: No L0 change is required. The frozen owners already require a per-execution/per-attempt append-only ledger, a shared cfg-only handle, local runtime identities, emission at real hooks and projection without fabrication. The challenge, append receipts and preprojection raw snapshot are test-only evidence for those existing obligations and do not change normal API, behavior, defaults or pipeline phase.
scope: focal real ContextBlock to CounterUpdate::Func to walk/replay to syntax-body and ordered Dict binding
normal/repeat/reverse independence for later sealed cases

closed_world.unknown_members: Violated at every object depth, including manifest, raw snapshot, append receipt, event, refs, data, typed value and projection
closed_world.primitive_types: exact JSON primitive type; bool never satisfies integer

runtime_origin_proof.challenge: Before each execution, the independent test driver supplies 32 fresh unpredictable bytes to the cfg-only ledger constructor. The candidate must not choose, replace or read the next run's challenge. normal, repeat and reverse challenges are pairwise distinct.
runtime_origin_proof.challenge_commitment: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the 32 challenge bytes
runtime_origin_proof.identity_namespace: Every serialized run, ledger, cell, session-carrier, occurrence-carrier, Func, SyntaxNode, Content, Location, snapshot and Dict identity is a domain-tagged token bound to challenge_commitment and its first real allocation/hook receipt. Fixed literals or identical concrete IDs across fresh challenges are Violated. Runtime addresses are neither serialized nor frozen.
runtime_origin_proof.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme for event bytes and raw snapshots; exact integers and UTF-8 strings only
runtime_origin_proof.event_digest: SHA-256(canonical event without any receipt field)
runtime_origin_proof.append_time_rule: The sole raw-ledger writer computes and appends event plus receipt atomically at the declared hook. seq is the actual tail length and hook_hit is the actual per-hook counter. The raw prefix is immutable.
runtime_origin_proof.preprojection_rule: At H16, after all cells reject further appends, the test driver obtains an immutable RawLedgerSnapshot and independently records raw_digest. Projection consumes that frozen snapshot read-only. The driver hashes the raw snapshot again after projection and requires equality.
runtime_origin_proof.proof_limit: The chain alone does not prove productive origin because a candidate can know its challenge during the run. Therefore Preserved additionally requires candidate-verifier source inspection, runtime hook coverage and direct preprojection snapshot inspection defined below. A projected DTO alone can never establish append-only origin.

event_schemas.carrier_rule: same session_carrier; occurrence carrier not yet available
first occurrence_carrier binding; all downstream occurrence events must equal it
same session and occurrence carriers as creation
same carriers and Location as walked occurrence
same carriers; endpoints equal adjacent dispatches
same carriers; syntax_kind CodeBlock and role syntax-body, never Func
same carriers and body identity as enter; real result/error/FlowEvent
same carriers, Location and snapshot_pre as replay-enter; snapshot_post is the actual converted post-state or a closed error outcome
same session_carrier; exactly once after all events attributable to the origin cell

continuity.session_carrier: identical at every event in an origin cell
continuity.occurrence_carrier: identical from counter-occurrence-created through walked, replay, both Func dispatches, With edge, syntax-body enter/witness/exit and replay exit
continuity.location: the exact Location value and challenge-bound identity from H11 must be reused at H12A and H12B; no equivalent/reconstructed Location is accepted
continuity.snapshot_pre: H12A captures the local state before apply_func; H12B repeats the exact identity and typed value
continuity.snapshot_post: H12B captures the state after the real callback result is validated and immediately before the same history append; its identity is challenge-bound to H12B and its typed value must equal the value appended to history
continuity.with_endpoints: H14 outer equals the immediately preceding H13 callback-with; H14 inner equals the immediately following H13 func-callback and the Func received by H15
continuity.syntax_body: H15 enter/exit and H05 witness use the exact ClosureRepr.body SyntaxNode, parser kind CodeBlock, span 64..121

attempt_kind_and_R.attempt_kind_source: Derived exclusively from the live H00D or H00S receipt immediately preceding H01. No attempt.kind field can override it.
attempt_kind_and_R.discovery: H00D=1, H00S=0, H11=0 and R=0 for the focal occurrence; the discovery result is retired before the selected history starts.
attempt_kind_and_R.selected: H00D=0 and H00S=1. H11 is 1 exactly when the result is incorporated, otherwise 0 with a closed non-incorporated result.
attempt_kind_and_R.R_definition: For an origin cell, R is the number of verified H12A receipts whose occurrence_carrier is that cell's created carrier. R is absent from the DTO schema and may be zero or greater; it is never inferred from declared semantic events alone.
attempt_kind_and_R.R_relations: H12B=R; H13=2R ordered With then Closure; H14=R; H15 enter=R and exit=R; dict-witness=R. Each replay names the selected consumer_cell in which it actually ran while retaining the original occurrence origin_cell.
attempt_kind_and_R.late_append: Replay events may append to an earlier selected origin cell during a later selected consumer cell. H03 is only result capture; H16 closes cells after stabilization, so no false early close is allowed.

classification_precedence: 1. Validate exact sealed hashes, closed manifest metadata and Rust symbol/branch binding.
2. Validate fresh challenges, raw preprojection evidence, receipt chain, identity namespace and immutable projection boundary.
3. Validate closed schemas, types, roles and event kinds for every event, including extras.
4. Validate attempt-kind/R cardinalities, all carrier/endpoints, Location, snapshots, spans, ordered typed values and causal order.
5. Only if steps 1-4 all pass may deliberate opacity of dict-witness yield Unknown. Any earlier failure is Violated.
unknown_policy: Unknown is permitted only when dict-witness is explicitly authored opaque with a valid SHA-256 commitment after every non-payload predicate passes. Prebound opacity, missing payload without deliberate marker, carrier loss, bad metadata, bad receipt, stale challenge, identity reuse, wrong span/type/cardinality/Location/snapshot or post-hoc evidence is Violated. Unknown is never Preserved and never seals a positive case.

ordering_runs.normal: frozen case list in authored order with fresh World, ledger and verifier challenge
ordering_runs.repeat: same list/order with a second fresh World, ledger and pairwise-distinct challenge
ordering_runs.reverse: same cases in reverse order with a third fresh World, ledger and pairwise-distinct challenge
ordering_runs.fixed_id_rejection: Every challenge-bound identity set must be disjoint across the three runs. A06 fixed IDs is a valid negative and must be Violated, not relabelled invalid.
ordering_runs.posthoc_rechain_rejection: A07 is a valid negative. Changing DTO seq/IDs/predecessors without the matching frozen raw snapshot and append receipts is Violated; rebuilding both before freeze remains subject to mandatory source/runtime inspection and cannot be accepted from JSON alone.
ordering_runs.classification_relation: same case classification across normal/repeat/reverse; stability never rescues a surviving negative

checker_must_validate: contract, manifest, fixture, L0 freeze and corpus hashes supplied by the seal, not values trusted from the DTO
exact byte hash of the R2 manifest and every closed metadata key/type/enum/value
Rust-aware unique symbol/branch anchors, exclusion of cfg(test) decoys and candidate hook-call adjacency under cfg(p1339_observation)
all raw/event/projection closed schemas and every event, including unexpected extras
challenge format and pairwise freshness commitments across normal/repeat/reverse
receipt formula, seq, hook_hit, predecessor chain, event digests, preprojection raw_digest and read-only projection equality
challenge-bound domain identities, cross-run disjointness and all carrier/endpoint/Location/snapshot continuity rules
attempt-kind from H00 receipts, R from H12A receipts and every relational cardinality
parser spans, exact typed Dict order/value, no bool-as-int and full causal order
classification precedence so non-payload failures are Violated before opacity is considered
candidate_verifier_must_inspect: issue each 32-byte challenge outside candidate control after the run process/test is ready and before ledger construction
observe the raw ledger directly in memory at H16 before any DTO projection, store its independent digest, and confirm the same raw object/digest after projection
inspect source to prove there is one encapsulated raw-ledger append writer, projection is read-only, and no alternate constructor/rechain path can populate raw events or receipts
inspect every manifest hook in its declared productive Rust branch, confirm runtime coverage receipts from the exact fixture, and reject cfg(test) decoys or dead branches
trace the same carrier through Func, CounterUpdateElem/payload, walk, child EvalContext, both dispatches and syntax-body without name/address/output lookup or global side table
inspect that H11 reads the real Content/Location/action, H12A reads the real pre-state and H12B reads the actual validated post-state immediately before history append
confirm callback count equals real apply_func invocations and observation adds no callback execution
confirm normal/repeat/reverse perform distinct fresh executions and no challenge or serialized identity is hard-coded
treat raw receipt algebra as necessary but not sufficient; never infer productive origin solely from a final JSON sequence

blocker_closure.B01: exact manifest hash, closed metadata, Rust symbol/branch resolution, cfg(test) exclusion and live receipt coverage
blocker_closure.B02: same session/occurrence carrier at every edge plus exact With endpoints, Location and real pre/post snapshot continuity
blocker_closure.B03: closed event kinds/roles/types, immutable raw snapshot before projection and per-hook append chain; DTO-only coherence is insufficient
blocker_closure.B04: verifier-issued fresh challenge, challenge-bound identities, cross-run disjointness and direct raw/source inspection
blocker_closure.B05: ordered fail-closed precedence evaluates all non-payload predicates before deliberate opacity

requirements: deliberate opaque Unknown only after non-payload pass
